in_marathi.name: Dayaananda
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Giver of joy, benevolent
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dayaananda हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dayaananda is a Sanskrit name, derived from the words 'daya' (joy, happiness) and 'ananda' (bliss, joy). This name signifies a giver of joy, a benevolent soul. In Hindu mythology, there is a sage named Dayananda Saraswati, who is revered for his wisdom and compassion. He is the founder of the Arya Samaj movement, promoting the Vedic teachings and social reforms.
